newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom's Wanadoo plans autumn campaign.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom's Wanadoo plans autumn campaign.

text.p: Wanadoo, France Telecom's Internet service provider, plans a major promotion for this autumn to boost its market share, Michel Bon, France Telecom chairman, told a news conference.
Speaking at a multimedia trade show on Tuesday in Le Mans, Bon also said Wanadoo currently had 43,000 subscribers.
"We are going to announce a Wanadoo offer after the summer. We are going to accelerate strongly," he said, declining to give further details.
Some observers criticise Wanadoo for being too expensive compared to big U.S. Internet service providers.
Bon did not exclude the possibility of a link with Infonie, an independent French service provider, which has run into financial difficulties after a tough launch period.
"If it seems that a link with a particular competitor is beneficial for clients, why not?" Bon said in answer to questions.
Wanadoo was launched in the spring of 1996. A France Telecom source said Wanadoo would break even when it had 300,000 subscribers. WEM/SLA
